message: Fixed and verified. Splitting one hundred dollars three ways now settles everyone to $0.00.

plan.title: Rounding / settlement leaves $0.01 owed after split $100 3 ways
plan.url: 127.0.0.1:5174 - Visible in browser address bar throughout video. Title: Lisbon trip - Tally
plan.expected: After adding a $100 expense paid by Alex split equally 3-ways = $33.33 each. Suggested payments Sam pays Alex $33.33 and Jo pays Alex $33.33. After clicking Settle up all balances should be $0.00 / owes nothing. Alex should be owed $0.00, `TOTAL SPENT $100.00` remains, Expenses list shows settlement transfers.
plan.actual: After clicking Settle up for a $100 expense split 3-ways, balances do not settle to zero. Instead `Balances` shows `Alex is owed $0.01` while `Sam owes nothing` and `Jo owes nothing`. $0.01 remains due to rounding error - never reaches $0.00 / owes nothing.

steps.target: Address bar shows 127.0.0.1:5174 - Tab: Lisbon trip - Tally
Add expense > Description input placeholder e.g. Dinner at Taberna
Settle up button blue at bottom of Balances card

before.evidence: Balances shows 'Alex is owed $0.01' while 'Sam owes nothing' and 'Jo owes nothing', with Expenses 'Jo paid Alex $33.33', 'Sam paid Alex $33.33', 'Dinner $100.00' and 'TOTAL SPENT $100.00'

fix.root_cause: splitEvenly rounded each share to 3333 cents so shares summed to 9999 instead of 10000, leaving a 1-cent balance no settlement could clear.
fix.summary: Changed splitEvenly to floor shares and distribute the leftover remainder cents to the first members so shares always sum to the exact expense.
fix.message: Fixed by muse-code; tests pass and the regression test fails on the old code.

after.evidence: AFTER Balances shows 'Alex owes nothing', 'Sam owes nothing', 'Jo owes nothing' plus 'All settled up Everyone is square. Nice trip!' with TOTAL SPENT $100.00 and Expenses 'Jo paid Alex $33.33' and 'Sam paid Alex $33.33' - the $0.01 owed is gone
